nodes.title: fix(uninstall): match a version prefix only at a version boundary
nodes.body: Fixes #15110: `mise uninstall ruby 3.4.1` removed 3.4.12. A query now names a version only up to a `.` or `-`.

commit.messageHeadline: fix(uninstall): match a version prefix only at a version boundary

nodes.body: Hard-coding `.` and `-` as the only boundaries skips the backend's own matching: java accepts a `+` build after any query, so `java@temurin-21.0.1` no longer finds `temurin-21.0.1+12`. That's the e2e failure. Match each candidate through `backend.fuzzy_match_filter` instead.
Please add unit tests for the matching, at least `1.1.1` against `1.1.12` and a query that names the whole version.
Does `mise uninstall node@20` still find every installed 20.x?
